Q: How do i fix "SCRIPT ERROR: No such export getSharedObject in resource es_extended " error in fivem? A:

Change it with ESX = exports["es_extended"]:getSharedObject() as the esx:getSharedObject export is now deprecated, also the new version helps a lot with modders.

Q: SVN options in STS - Existing Maven project A: 
or

In Eclipse, go to the Help menu → Install New Software... Click Add... http://community.polarion.com/projects/subversive/download/eclipse/3.0/kepler-site/ In Location copy the URL for the Subversive SVN Connectors Click OK Check Subversive SVN Connectors Click Next, and then follow the instructions to complete installation

Q: Git automatically identifying the common ancestor for an "onto" rebase A:

Run git merge-base feature1 feature2, then use that SHA-1 hash in your call to onto
